author: John (identified by tradition as the apostle)
authorNote: Christians read Revelation in different ways: as about events in the first century, across church history, at the end of time, or as timeless symbol. Many combine these.
date: c. AD 95 (some date it c. AD 68)
overview: John receives visions while exiled on the island of Patmos. Through vivid symbols (lamb, dragon, beasts, a city) it shows that Jesus, the slain Lamb, has won, and that God will judge evil and make all things new. It encourages persecuted Christians to stay faithful.
storyPlace: The final book of the Bible. It ends where Genesis began: with God dwelling with his people in a renewed creation.
